name: Opt-in Pop-up (4 steps)
purpose: Turn site traffic into owned subscribers at the highest submit rate possible, and learn which of three product groups / goals each subscriber came for so Welcome Email #1 opens on their problem, not ours.
routesTo: welcome: conditional split on the answer → Email #1 (Option #1) / #1 v2 (Option #2) / #1 v3 (Option #3)

steps.name: Teaser + Collect Zero Party Data
steps.headline: Want {{offers.welcome}}?
goals: Headline states exactly the welcome offer the subscriber gets (the Email #5 upgrade is never promised up front)
One question with three answers; each answer must map to real products (the three groups new customers actually start with: DATA)
Answers are worded the way a shopper would say them
Gets a micro-commitment before asking for the email, which lifts opt-in rate
Creative: the hero product for the brand, nothing else competing

steps.name: Collect Email
steps.headline: Where should we send it?
steps.subheadline: {{offers.welcome}} off your first order, plus [what else they get: guide, early access, the breakdown people ask for]
goals: Optional trust line under the button

steps.name: Collect SMS (optional for the subscriber)
steps.headline: Want it texted to you too?
steps.subheadline: Angle on what SMS gets them: restock alerts, new flavours/drops, early access. A few texts a month.
steps.consent: By submitting you agree to receive recurring automated marketing texts. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel.

steps.name: Confirmation
steps.headline: You're in.
steps.subheadline: Your code is {{offers.welcome_code}} for {{offers.welcome}} off [where it works]. It's in your inbox now.
goals: The code, where it works (exclusions), one button to shop

replenishable.example: What is your primary wellness goal right now? (supplements)
What are you shopping for today? Salts / Seasoning Blends / ... (SPQR)
How do you like your jerky? (El Viejon)
What's the hardest part of staying consistent? (Moneta) / What are you hoping LEVL helps with? Afternoon slump / Stress + recovery / Everyday hydration
What are you researching right now? (peptides)

one_off.example: What are you shopping for? Classic Gold Chains / Gold Rings / Everyday Bracelets (Gold Urban)
Who are you shopping for? (LGNDRY Fit)
What's your style preference? Classic & Timeless / Warm & Versatile / Modern & Bold (Daily Belts)
What occasion are you shopping for? Birthday / Wedding or formal / Vacation (Ellaé Lisqué)
What type of fence do you have? (FencePot)
Buy A Drone / Repair My Drone / Upgrade My Fleet (Drone Doctor)

offerOptions: Dollar off for high-ticket, framed as a welcome gift (Orion Moto: $25 off)
Tiered/bundle savings (Daily Belts: unlock up to 30% off)
No discount for expert-led or service brands (Drone Doctor: a free expert recommendation)
strategyNote: Why this question: it gets a micro-commitment and tells us which pain point / product group the subscriber walked in with
Where the answer is stored ({{popup.property}}) and that it's reused in campaigns and launches
That the headline offer is exactly what they get; the Email #5 upgrade lands as a genuine upgrade

variables.description: Profile property that stores the step-1 answer
Answer #1 (a product group / goal new customers start with)
The one product step 1 and 4 feature
